row.name: GitLab Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 9 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=6 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.31 tightness=0.78 base_volume_vs_leg=1.02 base_volume_vs_avg=1.02
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 9.4% vs its 20-SMA, 15.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The chart shows this is breakout number 9 of a 92% move that began in May — the shaded base sits near the top of a long, extended staircase with eight prior pushes already behind it, making this the definition of a late-stage, exhausted trend. The burst bar itself is not the widest of the last five bars (RE: FAIL), and volume came in below the prior session (VOL: FAIL), so the range expansion and sponsorship that define a valid burst are both absent. The base inside the shaded box contains wide red bars including a large-range down day that dropped from ~55 to ~46, which is a 17% intrabar swing — that is not a tight, orderly consolidation.
claude.key_risk: Nine breakouts into a 92% extended move means the next sellers are the buyers from every prior burst, and only 2 of the last 4 breakouts closed higher three sessions later.
claude.entry_note: Skip regardless of open price — the setup fails RE and VOL mechanically and the trend age alone disqualifies it under Y.

row.summary: GTLB: +4.8% on 1.0× volume out of a base 17.2% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
